dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This visit to Nod-Krai has proven most rewarding. Beyond the delight of witnessing some splendid natural scenery, I've also had the privilege of learning from this distinctive martial contest.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Your presence at the event has also given one much more food for thought. I should certainly write down what I've witnessed in my travel journal...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It is almost time for me to return to The Crux fleet. When my journal is finished, I would be honored if you could spare a moment to read them.

choices.text: Yeah, we should work together like this more often.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I'm sure there will be more opportunities like this. I look forward to seeing you again.

choices.text: And we can also go sightseeing next time.
